decisions.reason: Selecting Balanced Flow kerning does not change the É accent's literal derivation; its separate terminal change from the same message is already represented.

The same-message preservation Event already requires all other established decisions to remain unchanged while terminal treatments vary, so no additional kerning-specific update is necessary.

The source postpones proceeding with material treatments but does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish or its required character.
